# Embabel RAG Graph

> Graph-backed RAG for the Embabel Agent Framework: chunk, section and document storage with vector
> and full-text search on Neo4j, FalkorDB and Memgraph, through Drivine.

## Rules for changing this code

- Go through Drivine's `GraphObjectManager` first: `@NodeFragment` models, `@GraphView`s and the
  generated query DSL (`gom.loadAll`, `gom.saveAll`, `gom.delete`). Drivine writes the Cypher for the
  configured engine, so the same model runs on Neo4j, FalkorDB and Memgraph.
- Do not copy the hand-written Cypher that exists elsewhere in this repository as a pattern for
  `GraphObjectManagerStore`. Write Cypher there only when the object manager has no reasonable way
  to say it, for features or for speed, and say why at the site.
- When Drivine cannot express something, prefer adding the feature to Drivine
  (https://github.com/liberation-data/drivine4j) over working around it here.
- Order by a property only with a range index that mirrors the ordering. Drivine's index advisor
  warns when none does.
- Put each `@NodeFragment` and `@GraphView` in its own file under `graph/model`.
- A change must pass on all three engines. The cross-engine suite is
  `AbstractRagSearchCharacterizationTest` and its Neo4j, FalkorDB and Memgraph subclasses.

## Where things are

- [README](README.md): overview, configuration and testing.
- `src/main/kotlin/com/embabel/agent/rag/graph/GraphObjectManagerStore.kt`: the store.
- `src/main/kotlin/com/embabel/agent/rag/graph/model/`: fragments and views.
